structured_tasks.reasoning_from_chatgpt: This plan leverages a modern, fast, and easy-to-maintain stack suitable for MVP development. The frontend-only approach with localStorage reduces complexity while providing a good UX. This setup allows easy future upgrades to add a backend if needed.

tasks.title: Setup project with Vite, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
tasks.details: Initialize the project foundation using a modern toolchain to ensure a fast development server and an optimized build process. This is the bedrock for all subsequent development.
subtasks: Scaffold a new project using Vite with the 'react-ts' template.
Install and configure TailwindCSS for utility-first styling.
Configure TypeScript (`tsconfig.json`) for strict type checking.
Ensure the initial app renders a 'Hello World' page without errors.
Set up the project directory structure as defined by Claude's architecture (components, hooks, types, utils).

tasks.title: Define Data Model and State Management Hooks
tasks.details: Establish the core data structures and business logic for the application. This centralizes state management, making the app predictable and easier to debug.
subtasks: Create `types/todo.ts` with the `Todo` and `TodoState` interfaces.
Implement the `hooks/useTodos.ts` custom hook to encapsulate all state logic (add, edit, delete, toggle).
Ensure all state updates are immutable to prevent side effects.
Use UUIDs for new task IDs to ensure uniqueness.

tasks.title: Implement Core UI Components
tasks.details: Build the primary visual elements of the application. These components are responsible for rendering the todo list and handling user input.
subtasks: Create `TodoInput.tsx` to allow users to add new todo items via text input and button/enter key.
Create `TodoList.tsx` to display the list of todo items.
Create `TodoItem.tsx` to display an individual task's text, a completion checkbox, and a delete button.
Implement inline editing functionality for `TodoItem.tsx`.
Ensure components receive state and dispatch functions via props from the root `App.tsx` component.

tasks.title: Implement localStorage Persistence Layer
tasks.details: Ensure that the application state persists across browser sessions. This task involves creating an abstraction for interacting with localStorage.
subtasks: Create `hooks/useLocalStorage.ts` as a generic hook for state persistence.
Integrate the hook with `useTodos` to save the `todos` array whenever it changes.
Ensure the state is correctly loaded from localStorage on initial application start.
Implement comprehensive error handling for localStorage operations (e.g., quota exceeded, access denied).
Todos must persist across browser refreshes.

tasks.title: Add Filtering and Status UI
tasks.details: Implement UI controls that allow users to filter their tasks and see a summary of their progress, enhancing the user experience.
subtasks: Create `TodoFilters.tsx` component with tabs for 'All', 'Active', and 'Completed' views.
Implement filtering logic within the `useTodos` hook or the `TodoList` component.
Create `TodoStats.tsx` component to display a counter of remaining tasks ('X items left').
Add a 'Clear Completed' button to remove all completed tasks.
Ensure the UI correctly updates to reflect the currently active filter.

tasks.title: Implement Drag-and-Drop Reordering
tasks.details: Add a highly requested user feature to allow manual reordering of tasks, improving task prioritization.
subtasks: Install and configure `@hello-pangea/dnd`.
Integrate drag-and-drop context into `TodoList.tsx`.
Make `TodoItem.tsx` draggable.
Implement the reordering logic in the state management hook.
Ensure reordering is persisted to localStorage.

tasks.title: Create README.md Documentation
tasks.details: Provide essential documentation for developers to set up, run, and understand the project.
subtasks: Write a clear project description and its purpose.
Include step-by-step setup and installation instructions.
Provide examples for running the development server and building the project.
Document the available scripts in `package.json`.

tasks.title: Generate API.md and ARCHITECTURE.md
tasks.details: Create detailed technical documentation that outlines the application's structure and data flow, aiding future maintenance and onboarding.
subtasks: Create `ARCHITECTURE.md` outlining the component structure, state flow, and key design decisions.
Create `API.md` describing the data model (`Todo` interface) and the public interface of the `useTodos` hook.
Include diagrams where appropriate to visualize the architecture.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Core Components and Logic
tasks.details: Verify the correctness of individual components and hooks in isolation to catch bugs early and ensure reliability.
subtasks: Set up Jest and React Testing Library.
Write tests for the `useTodos` hook, covering all CRUD operations and filtering logic.
Write tests for UI components to assert they render correctly based on props.
Mock localStorage for persistence tests.
Achieve at least 80% test coverage for critical logic.

tasks.title: Implement End-to-End (E2E) Tests
tasks.details: Simulate real user workflows from start to finish to validate the integrated application and catch issues that unit tests might miss.
subtasks: Set up an E2E testing framework like Playwright or Cypress.
Write an E2E test for the critical path: adding a new task.
Write an E2E test for marking a task as complete and verifying the filter.
Write an E2E test for deleting a task.

tasks.title: Perform Security Checks and Code Hardening
tasks.details: Identify and mitigate potential security vulnerabilities to protect the user and the application.
subtasks: Run `npm audit` to check for vulnerabilities in dependencies and fix any critical issues.
Review all user input fields and implement sanitization to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks.
Ensure third-party libraries are from trusted sources and are up-to-date.
Review for compliance with OWASP Top 10 for web applications.

tasks.title: Perform Code Quality Analysis
tasks.details: Enforce coding standards and best practices to ensure the codebase is clean, maintainable, and performant.
subtasks: Configure and run ESLint and Prettier to enforce a consistent code style.
Ensure no type errors are detected by the TypeScript compiler in strict mode.
Set up pre-commit hooks using Husky to automate linting and formatting.
Review for performance optimizations, such as using `React.memo` and `useCallback` to prevent unnecessary re-renders in `TodoItem`.

execution_order.note: Setup phase. Foundational and must be completed first.

Parallel development of UI, persistence, and basic documentation.
Implementation of filtering and stats UI.
Implementation of UX enhancements like drag-and-drop.
Final parallel phase for all documentation, testing, security, and quality assurance tasks.
